tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: Countries (and trade blocs) with data: ISO code, region, a one-line headline and which topics each one has.

tools.name: find_visas
tools.description: Search digital nomad, retirement (pensionado) and investor visas across countries, cheapest entry first. Filter by the most a person can show: monthly USD income for digital_nomad and retirement, USD investment for investor. Returns summary rows; use get_country_profile for full requirements.

tools.name: get_country_profile
tools.description: Everything on one country, starting with a summary (headline sentence, lowest visa minimums, years to citizenship, tax system, monthly cost, safety rank, programs researched and found not to exist, and the oldest and newest verification dates). Then: visas, years from residency to permanent residenc

tools.name: compare_countries
tools.description: Side-by-side rows for several countries on one topic, e.g. tax_systems for Panama, Paraguay and Uruguay.

tools.name: get_dataset
tools.description: Every row of one topic, optionally for one country. Requires a commercial API key: https://mylatinlife.com/api/v1/plan?src=tools

tools.name: check_tax_blacklists
tools.description: Which tax and AML blacklists or greylists (EU Annex I/II, OECD, FATF, national lists) a jurisdiction is on, with legal basis and consequences.
